product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables users to create professional Arabic websites in under 5 minutes without coding.

product.name: Wuilt E-commerce Store Builder
product.description: An online platform for creating and managing Arabic e-commerce stores with product management, payment integration, and mobile optimization.

product.name: Wuilt Shipping Service (شحنات ويلت)
product.description: A shipping management service integrated with major Egyptian courier companies, enabling order tracking and shipment handling from a single platform.

product.description: A secure email service providing professional email addresses with calendar, tasks, notes, and bookmarks, linked to the user's domain.
